title: Money, Money, Money
lyrics:
[00:12.15]I work all night, I work all day
[00:14.15]To pay the bills I have to pay
[00:17.34]Ain't it sad?
[00:20.04]And still there never seems to be
[00:22.05]A single penny left for me
[00:25.20]That's too bad
[00:28.26]In my dreams, I have a plan
[00:32.57]If I got me a wealthy man
[00:36.00]I wouldn't have to work at all

[00:46.85]Money, money, money

[01:24.47]A man like that is hard to find
[01:26.58]But I can't get him off my mind
[01:29.70]Ain't it sad?

[01:34.45]I bet he wouldn't fancy me
[01:37.68]That's too bad
[01:40.44]So I must leave, I'll have to go
